title: Product smoke and real harness checks
summary: Native Windows smoke collects runtime/api, runtime/harness and tests with -m windows. Contributors declare pytest.mark.windows directly in their own modules, at module level or on individual tests. The collection hook skips unmarked modules before import so Unix-only tests cannot break Windows collection; pytest still filters individual tests. Collection and execution logs are retained, and an empty selection fails. No shared roster is edited.
